R01.text: Over 28 baseline days and 14 window days, all metrics remained stable. Sleep duration averaged ~470 min with wake fixed at 07:00 and start varying ~22:43-22:58. Steps (~8000), activity (~55 min), low movement (~450 min), resting HR (55-57 bpm), and RMSSD (26-54 ms) showed no sustained shifts. A single evening activity interval occurred daily. Weekday RMSSD variance exceeded weekends. No meaningful cross-metric relationships emerged.
